plan.problem: Local AI agents have no coordination layer - each runs in isolation with no shared memory, no task routing, no skill registry
plan.solution: A lightweight local-first agent operating system: process registry, task queue, shared memory bus, skill loader, and status dashboard in one CLI

build_phases.name: Agent Registry + Task Queue
build_phases.description: SQLite-backed agent registry, task queue with priority, --demo shows agents registering and claiming tasks

build_phases.name: Shared Memory Bus + Skill Loader
build_phases.description: Key-value memory store agents can read/write, skill discovery from ~/jarvis/products/, --demo shows memory sharing

build_phases.name: Status Dashboard + Polish
build_phases.description: ASCII dashboard showing all agents, queue depth, memory usage, active skills. --demo runs full simulation
